1875

Independent Committee in relation to the  
Fire at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po  

2nd Witness Statement of Leung Ping Kay  

I, Leung Ping Kay, of ████████████████████████████████████, do say as follows:-  

1. I am the same Leung Ping Kay who made a statement dated 2 March 2026 ("1st Witness Statement") (at Bundle WS2 (1509-1517)) pursuant to the request of the Committee.  

2. I make this Witness Statement to supplement my 1st Witness Statement and to provide a fuller account of the background to assist the Committee. Save where otherwise appears, I adopt the abbreviations and nomenclature used in my 1st Witness Statement. For certain terminology, I have provided both English and Chinese to avoid any confusion arising from translation.  

(A) Personal Background  

3. My name is Ivan Leung. I am ███████████████████.  

4. My highest level of education is a Diploma of Vocational Education (Building Services Engineering) (職專文憑（屋宇裝備工程）) obtained from the Institute of Vocational Education (IVE) (專業教育學院).
